sources.entry: PictShare - Multi lingual image hosting service with a simple resizing and upload API. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: PictShare is a self-hosted file host for images, GIFs, MP4 videos, audio, and text pastes, with URL-based resizing and filters and a simple upload API.
summary.what_it_does: PictShare stores uploaded images, GIFs, MP4s, audio files, and text bins on your own server, with no database required since it is file based. Images and videos can be resized, filtered, or rotated by editing the URL, and GIFs can be converted to MP4. JPG and PNG files can be converted to WebP when the requesting browser supports it. It removes EXIF data on upload, and identical files are stored once with duplicates linking to the first copy. Uploads can be grouped into immutable albums with a single gallery URL, and it includes URL shortening, Markdown rendering, identicon and placeholder image generation, and optional external storage with encryption. A built-in MCP endpoint lets LLM agents upload and manage files.
use_cases: share images and videos with a direct link
resize or filter images via URL parameters
upload files from scripts or an API
let LLM agents upload files via MCP
bundle uploads into a shared album
notable: File-based storage with no database needed
Image and video transformations controlled entirely by the URL
Built-in MCP server at POST /mcp for LLM agents
Albums and a browser-side 'My Uploads' tab
caveats: v3 may not be fully compatible with previous PictShare versions and drops several config options (TITLE, UPLOAD_FORM_LOCATION, ALLOW_BLOATING)
Several roadmap items are still unchecked, including upload quotas, autodestruct, and URL shortening upload
The file name must now be the last part of the URL, which breaks older link formats
